answer: Rule: every new identity enters through one inlet only: an established identity sponsors it by locking 500 POA for 20 epochs. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor stake is slashed and the slash ripples up the chain, so a garden of N fakes costs N locked stakes, and one detection can burn the whole branch. Cost per fake: 500 POA locked; exposure grows faster than linear because each extra fake raises the chance the cluster is found and slashed together.
